parsed.refutation_attempt: The reported issue claims OS command injection via the use of glob() with a user-supplied search pattern. In this code, glob() is used solely to generate a list of file paths matching the pattern; it does not invoke a shell or execute any command. The subsequent calls to processFile() open each matched file with fopen() and print its contents. This flow does not perform any command execution, so it does not meet the definition of OS command injection (CWE‑784). Therefore, even if searchPattern were derived from untrusted input, the code does not provide a vector for command injection.
